extraction.name: ArtifactsBench
extraction.description: A benchmark and automated, multimodal evaluation paradigm for visual code generation. It comprises 1,825 diverse tasks across nine domains to evaluate LLMs on generating interactive visual artifacts using temporal screenshots and fine-grained, checklist-guided judging.
extraction.creator: Tencent Hunyuan Team
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Candidates were aggregated from expert showcases, open SVG/web-snippet datasets, web case studies, and LLM visual-to-query from screenshots. Automated filters dropped incomplete, non-visual, license-violating, duplicate, trivial, or non-interactive items to prioritize dynamics.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Secondary Data analysis, Manual Human Curator, Others
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Expert showcases, open SVG/web-snippet datasets, web case studies, and LLM visual-to-query from screenshots.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: A two-stage filtering process was applied using MinHash and semantic similarity over prompts, checklists, and normalized DOM/CSS/JS, followed by screenshot perceptual hashing to discard visually near-identical artifacts. Experts and LLMs rewrote prompts for clarity, completeness, and stylistic diversity, verified by humans. Solvability validation and ambiguity repair pruned underspecified tasks or brittle hacks.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Automated filters eliminated incomplete, non-visual, duplicate, or trivial items. Queries underwent LLM-based quality evaluation across Quality, Creativity, Relevance, Completeness, and Privacy dimensions.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Each query was paired with a 10-dimension checklist covering visual, interactional, and code qualities, drafted using Hunyuan-Turbos and refined by humans. A 10% manually curated seed was used to anchor calibration. For human validation, 280 queries were independently evaluated by multiple front-end engineers in a double-blind setup.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: Inter-annotator agreement on the 10% calibration seed achieved Cohen's kappa >= 0.8. Human ground-truth scores were computed as the median of individual annotators' ratings, and pairwise consistency rates (Pair ACC) were evaluated against automated referee models.
extraction.rai:annotatorDemographics: Engineers with extensive front-end development experience.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: The dataset construction pipeline incorporated a specific filtering step to ensure queries avoid requesting or involving sensitive personal information such as phone numbers, addresses, or other identifiable details.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: Minor discrepancies in fine-grained scoring of complex interactive tasks reflect potential cognitive biases in how different MLLMs interpret long-horizon interaction logic and dynamic visual feedback.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Dynamic behavior is evaluated by discrete sequential screenshots at fixed intervals, which may not fully capture the fluidity, correctness, and robustness of complex, long-horizon, or state-dependent interactions. The benchmark currently evaluates only single-turn generation rather than iterative, agentic multi-turn development and debugging.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Benchmarking and evaluating the capability of LLMs and MLLMs to generate interactive, executable visual artifacts (code, visuals, and interactions) from multimodal instructions.
